what: The ONLY allowance a failing test has (architecture round 2, A8). Its one consumer is tools/ci_publish.py data_tier(), which publishes past a failed tests check ONLY on the verdict tools/ci_gate.py check_tests attaches to it (known_red_verdict: its `ok` and its `allowed` list, nothing else) and names each allowed test in the publish record; a failed tests check that carries no verdict is red. The verdict allows a failure only when its exact pytest node id is listed here AND its failure text contains `expected_failure` as a whole phrase, pytest exited 1, the failures read from the short summary are all of them (their number equals pytest's own count), and every test pytest collected was reported once and counted: no early stop, a deselected count equal to the one the gate asked for (fewer blocks as well as more; --deselect matches node ids by prefix), every collected test accounted for on pytest's last line and reported on its own -v line, none of them twice (draw-5 ci 2: a conftest repeating the known test stood in for a NEW one), and no conftest the run loads binding a name that can narrow what pytest collects (collect_ignore, collect_ignore_glob, pytest_ignore_collect, pytest_plugins, pytest_pycollect_makeitem, ...; the list is not exhaustive) -- check_tests' `incomplete`, which must be a list and empty (draw-5 ci 3: None read as complete) (draw3_fix ci 2: under PYTEST_ADDOPTS=-x the known test alone failing was allowed while a NEW failure never ran; draw4_build ci 2 and 3: the earlier text claimed more than these readings show, and a result with no `incomplete` read as complete). No ini file of the tree is read, and python_files / python_classes / python_functions are pytest's defaults (draw-5 ci 1: an ini's norecursedirs narrowed collection). NOT detected: an installed plugin, or conftest code that narrows collection some other way. Anything else blocks. The gate itself still BLOCKS on every entry (D23: CI keeps blocking): in the data tier the tests check fails, in the hermetic tier check_known_red fails on this list. The classification's 'red' list (tools/ci_data_bound.json) is a measurement: it only ever blocks (check_known_red) and allows nothing. A newly measured red test is not listed here until Khoa ticks it. Draw-3 ci SERIOUS 2: this text said the same while data_tier still allowed by the classification's red list and the 12-line `details`; it is true since the draw-3 release fix to data_tier, and tools/tests/test_ci_gate.py runs the real data_tier to keep it true.
